newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: WEL Energy to raise prices from December 1.
newsitem.headline: WEL Energy to raise prices from December 1.

text.p: Hamilton-based WEL Energy said on Wednesday it was raising consumption-based line and energy charges from December 1, reflecting the impact on energy purchasing and transmission costs since the new wholesale market was launched.
The rise, the first in 17 months, would add about 57 cents per week to the average domestic electricity bill. Fixed charges would remain the same.

"The introduction of the wholesale electricity market has had a widespread impact on our energy purchasing and transmission costs. As these account for 70 percent of our overall costs, we have come under increasing pressure to raise prices," Chief Executive Graham Coxhead said.
He said Trans Power's decision to alter its charges for operation of the national grid, combined with the volatility of the new spot power market, represented the main components of the price rise.
